newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: David Jones to close Adelaide store-paper.
newsitem.headline: David Jones to close Adelaide store-paper.

text.p: Upmarket retailer David Jones Ltd would close its second Adelaide store and was looking at vacating a third, the Australian Financial Review said on Monday.

The newspaper said David Jones was expected to hand over its John Martin's store at Elizabeth to retailer Harris Scarfe Ltd on July 1 and was also in talks with Westfield Ltd on vacating its Kilkenny John Martin's store.
It was thought the Kilkenny store would be partly taken up by Coles Myer Ltd's Target chain, the newspaper said.

The moves follow David Jones' earlier decisions to close its main John Martin's Adelaide city store in Rundle Mall and to rebadge its John Martin's stores at Marion and Westlakes as David Jones' stores.
The Financial Review said David Jones managing director Peter Wilkinson expected to reach an agreement this week with Harris Scarfe on the Elizabeth transfer.
Wilkinson could not be contacted for comment.
